title: Looper mutation receipt (contract version 2)
description: The immediate document returned by looper add-task, add-plan, cancel, amend, config, requeue, and stop under contract version 2. It names the durable request, not the applied result; callers query or wait separately.

type.description: Request types a controller can advertise in its capabilities. A type absent from the controller advertisement is refused before queueing.

state.description: See docs/contracts/request-states.json. A receipt returned promptly reports submitted or accepted; applied results come from the request record.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-supplied key scoped to the project and operation. Repeating a key with the same payload returns the original request; a changed payload is a conflict.

duplicate.description: True when this receipt returns an existing request for the same idempotency key and payload.

note.description: States that a wait timeout is an outcome of the wait, never a cancellation of the request.
